(You may only have one "Red Charged Balls" attached. If this card is banished from your Life Deck, attach it to your MP.)

While attached, your Styled attacks deal +1 stage. [Warning]: Raise your anger 2.
DAMAGE: 3 stages.
HIT: Rejuvenate 1. [Trait:Alien]: Rejuvenate 3 instead.
